description:
Change or withdraw existing protections with owner approval (consent=true) and Watchtower write access (watch:manage). For a new canary or a delivery test, use vulkill_watchtower_manage.
• Use vulkill_watchtower_read to choose an existing item. Acknowledging an alert stops queued escalation. Revoking a canary is permanent. Publishing a badge exposes the hostname.
• A response request expires after 30 minutes and needs local approval. On retry, reuse the same UUID, kind, profile and context. Changing those inputs with the same UUID returns a conflict.
• Only the funding owner can pause renewal. Today’s paid coverage and saved reports remain available.

action.description: Choose one change. ack stops an alert’s queued escalation; weekly unsubscribes; timezone, delay and primary change notification settings. revokeCanary invalidates a decoy. trustPublish and trustHide publish or withdraw a badge. queue and cancel manage local response requests. pauseBilling stops daily renewal.

consent.description: True only after the account owner explicitly approves the specific change and its effects.

context.description: Required for queue. Use the installed profile’s non-secret local reference, or one IPv4/IPv6 address for block_ip. Never send a credential or a URL.

enabled.description: Required for weekly. False stops summaries and cancels queued summary deliveries. To subscribe, use vulkill_watchtower_manage.

id.description: For ack use the alert ID from events. For revokeCanary or cancel use the existing canary or response UUID from protection. For queue generate a fresh UUID and reuse it on retries.

kind.description: For queue only. Choose the response type supported by the installed local approval profile.

minutes.description: Required for delay. Minutes to wait before escalating an alert to the secondary recipient.

primary.description: Required for primary. oncall requires an existing paired responder.

profile.description: Required for queue. Choose a predefined local response profile name beginning with a lowercase letter, followed by lowercase letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.

target.description: Required for revokeCanary, trustPublish, trustHide, queue and cancel. Use the target UUID from overview. Publishing and queueing also require current DNS proof and active coverage.

timezone.description: Required for timezone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Istanbul. With weekly it is optional and only fills an unset time zone.

name: vulkill_watchtower_control

billing.description: Funding state returned by pauseBilling. Inspect state, renewalEnabled and paidToday to confirm the outcome.

hostname.description: Hostname used for the public badge. Null if the hostname was not assigned.

id.description: The local response request ID. Read protection to check its state.

ok.description: The requested setting, withdrawal or billing change was accepted.

slug.description: Public badge record ID returned by trustPublish.

title: Change or withdraw Watchtower protections
